body:
Water Supply & Wastewater Treatment Projects

TONGYANG supports water infrastructure and environmental engineering projects through industrial equipment manufacturing, engineering coordination and project-specific equipment supply.

Our project experience and cooperation network cover municipal water supply, raw-water intake facilities, wastewater treatment and industrial zero liquid discharge (ZLD) applications.

1. Yanziji Water Plant Renovation Project

Location: Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, China

The Yanziji Water Plant Renovation Project involves the upgrading of municipal drinking water treatment facilities with a treatment capacity of approximately 200,000 m³/day.

The project includes raw-water intake improvements, pumping and transmission facilities, advanced water treatment systems and supporting infrastructure. It aims to improve drinking water quality, strengthen water supply reliability and support the city's growing water demand.

Project Scope: Raw-water intake, pumping facilities, water treatment systems and associated infrastructure.

2. Dafeng Xintuan River Emergency Raw-Water Source Project

Location: Yancheng, Jiangsu Province, China

The project involves emergency raw-water supply infrastructure designed to support regional water security and provide alternative water source arrangements during exceptional operating conditions.

The engineering scope relates to raw-water intake, pumping and transmission facilities, as well as connections to the existing water supply network.

Project Scope: Emergency water intake, pumping systems, raw-water transmission and associated water supply infrastructure.

3. Dafeng Tongyu River Intake Upgrade and Enhanced Pretreatment Project

Location: Dafeng District, Yancheng, Jiangsu Province, China

The project focuses on upgrading raw-water intake facilities and strengthening pretreatment capabilities for the municipal drinking water supply system.

The improvement works involve water intake infrastructure, pumping and transmission facilities, enhanced pretreatment equipment and associated utility systems, supporting more reliable water treatment and supply operations.

Project Scope: Raw-water intake upgrading, enhanced pretreatment, pumping facilities and water transmission infrastructure.

4. Huayang Underground Wastewater Treatment Plant

Location: Tianfu New Area, Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China

The Huayang Underground Wastewater Treatment Plant is an urban environmental infrastructure project with a planned treatment capacity of approximately 180,000 m³/day.

The project integrates municipal wastewater treatment facilities within an underground structure, helping optimize urban land utilization while providing wastewater treatment services for the surrounding area.

Project Scope: Underground wastewater treatment facilities, biological treatment systems, sludge handling and associated mechanical and utility infrastructure.

5. Huaneng Zhengning Mine-Water Advanced Treatment and ZLD Project

Location: Zhengning County, Gansu Province, China

The project focuses on advanced treatment and zero liquid discharge of industrial mine water, supporting water reuse and environmental protection requirements.

The treatment system involves water purification, concentration, evaporation and crystallization processes to minimize wastewater discharge and improve industrial water resource utilization.

Equipment relevant to the project includes industrial storage tanks, heat exchangers, evaporation vessels and other process equipment.

Project Scope: Mine-water advanced treatment, wastewater concentration, evaporation and crystallization systems.

TONGYANG Equipment & Engineering Support

TONGYANG provides industrial equipment manufacturing, customized pressure vessels, storage tanks, heat exchangers, evaporation equipment and modular equipment packages for water and wastewater treatment applications.

Our participation in engineering projects is based on defined equipment supply and technical coordination responsibilities in cooperation with project partners.
